# Owner paths. A PR that changes one passes "Owner OK" only while it carries
# the owner-ok label that the owner set on its head commit, so a later push
# needs the label again (docs/plan.md, section 6). The approval workflow reads
# this file from the default branch, so a PR cannot change it for itself.
#
# The list is empty. Of all PRs, only those from outside contributors need
# the owner, and each of them needs the owner's approving review anyway
# ("Outside approval"). The owner's review agent reads everything else: the
# licences, the exceptions to the names rule and the database migrations
# too. With no owner path, no PR needs the label. Owner OK still fails a PR
# whose changed files GitHub cannot list in full (more than 3000), so that it
# holds again once a path is back on the list.
#
# The owner-ok label and its check stay, so the owner can put paths on this
# list again. A list that is not empty also names itself, so that a PR that
# shortens it for later PRs needs the owner too. CODEOWNERS mirrors the list.
#
# One glob per line, from the repository root: ** spans folders, * and ? stay
# inside one name, and a pattern without a slash matches at the root only.
# Matching ignores case.
